results.rationale: The skater's face, hair, clothing, pose and skateboard are retained while the requested blue poster setting is added. Yellow title, skyline, lightning, motion streaks and bottom call-to-action are present, but separate skateboard-part accents are absent. The subtitle overlaps the hair and becomes broken/partly illegible, an obvious typographic flaw; the figure remains coherent.

The plain white cup and lid retain their design. The cup is placed below center on pale wood with a blurred warm cafe background and the correct words at the top. However, the title uses a large outlined serif font rather than light dark-brown sans-serif, and the scene reads as an outdoor tabletop rather than light through cafe windows. The cup, shadows, wood and text are clean and coherent.
